description: Land Title Settlement Dept - Mahamelmaduwa, Mahawilachchiya D/S/D,
categorisation: The gazette content is a Land Redemption Notice under the Land Acquisition Act. Its primary subject is the divestment of a specific allotment of land (including its location, boundaries, and extent) from the State. While it is signed by a named Minister, the core purpose and detailed content are exclusively about a land/property transaction, making it a Land Gazette. The government personnel element is incidental to the execution of the land-related legal procedure.
